messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Sustained high p95 latency and lower throughput detected for inference region us-west-2. Pager triggered to on-call.
Jordan (on-call): acked. Jumping in. Adding infra and eng.
Marta (SRE): On it. What's the observed impact and any recent config pushes?
Jordan (on-call): p95 jumped from ~160ms -> ~1.2s on conv-chat and text-gen routes. Throughput down ~30% over the last 25m. Error type: client timeouts and internal 502s. No obvious global failover.
Liu (Infra): I see a correlation with a recent prefix-cache eviction policy change rolled 40m ago to reduce memory use. Several warm-pool nodes show cache miss storms and higher kernel stalls on longer contexts.
Priya (Product Ops): FYI we're preparing customer comms. Is this limited to us-west-2? Any Dedicated pools impacted?
Jordan (on-call): initial scope: primarily us-west-2 hosted traffic, a handful of Dedicated tenants routed through the same warm pool are seeing degradation.
CS Ops: customers reporting chat lags. Need ETA and possible workaround to pass back.
Marta (SRE): Immediate plan:
1) Revert prefix-cache eviction policy for us-west-2 (fast toggle).
2) Bring up additional warm-pool capacity (burst +25%) to absorb longer sequences.
3) Apply emergency QoS to throttle low-priority background ingest and retries.
I'll run (1) now and coordinate (2) with infra.
Liu (Infra): scaling warm-pool now. Expect new nodes healthy in ~6-8 minutes. Also investigating kernel stalls on 4 hosts; may need staggered restarts.
Jordan (on-call): go ahead with those. Priya please draft a conservative status update; keep Legal in loop.
Priya (Product Ops): draft for status page (keepsafe language):
```
Incident: Degraded inference performance in us-west-2
Impact: Customers in us-west-2 may experience increased response times (up to ~1–2s) and lower throughput for generation calls. Some requests may time out or be retried automatically.
Scope: Hosted API in us-west-2 and a small subset of Dedicated pools using the warm-pool routing. Not a global outage.
Mitigation: We have reverted a recent cache eviction policy in the region, scaled warm-pool capacity, and applied emergency QoS to non-critical background traffic. No customer data loss detected.
Next update: in 15 minutes or upon milestone.
```
Legal: wording looks fine. Avoid SLA or credit promises. Use "may" and "investigating".
CS Ops: I'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb for affected tenants offering immediate workarounds (reduce max_tokens or request pin to legacy-v0 model) - need concise copy.
Priya (Product Ops): customer blurb:
```
Hi <Customer>,

We9re investigating higher latency for inference in us-west-2. Engineers have reverted a cache policy and are scaling capacity. You may see improved performance in the next 30-90 minutes. Temporary workarounds include reducing max_tokens or requesting a pin to legacy-v0; reply and your account team will coordinate.

Thanks, Redwood Ops
```
Marta (SRE): eviction policy revert applied. Initial canary shows immediate improvement on toggled hosts (p95 down ~350ms). Proceeding with staggered restarts on 4 noisy hosts to clear kernel stalls.
Liu (Infra): warm-pool +25% up and healthy. Background jobs throttled by 60%. New nodes reporting normal kernel times so far.
Jordan (on-call): good. I'll hand primary to Marta in 30m for my break. Marta can you own until mitigation confirmed?
Marta (SRE): I can take primary. I'll watch the next two 10-minute windows and coordinate any further action (rollback, kernel patch revert).
statuspage-bot: Status page update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/rlw-2100000000 
Priya (Product Ops): internal support template for #support to copy/paste: 
"Heads up — us-west-2 inference degraded. Workarounds: reduce max_tokens, request pin to legacy-v0, or accept temporary model steering to q5 variants. Estimated recovery 30–90m. Escalate to Marta/Jordan if enterprise SLA customer impacted."
CS Ops: sending to affected accounts now. One enterprise asks for immediate pin; flagging Sales+Legal.
Liu (Infra): restarts completed. Kernel stalls cleared on those hosts. Overall region p95 now ~260–320ms; error rate near baseline.
Marta (SRE): monitoring. If stable for two consecutive 10m windows, we'll mark mitigated and draft postmortem. Please preserve traces and logs for root cause.
Jordan (on-call): thanks Marta. I'll attach my notes to the oncall doc and DM you a quick handoff summary.
Priya (Product Ops): status update: partial recovery observed; continuing monitoring. Next update in 20 minutes.
statuspage-bot: Status page: "Partial recovery observed; mitigation actions in progress. Next update in +20m or on milestone." posted.
Legal: remind support not to promise immediate SLA remedies. Any dedicated pinning must go through Sales + Legal.
CS Ops: one customer replied asking for technical details for their incident reporting — we'll provide a summary after postmortem.
Marta (SRE): metric windows stable for 20 minutes. Marking mitigated in monitoring. Drafting postmortem template: timeline, root cause (cache eviction policy interacting with warm-pool + kernel sensitivity to long sequences), short-term mitigations (policy revert, warm-pool scaling, QoS), long-term remediation (more conservative eviction heuristics, kernel perf regression tests, staged rollout by seq-length), customer impact log and comms.
Priya (Product Ops): preparing public postmortem summary for review. Legal will sign off before publish.
Jordan (on-call): great work team. Closing thread after postmortem draft in #postmortems in ~24h. Handing off pager to Marta now.
Marta (SRE): taking primary. Closing thread here.
